description: This file defines the AccountingProcessorHelper class, a utility component responsible for handling various accounting-related operations within the Fineract project. Its functionalities include populating data transfer objects from raw data, retrieving account mappings, and creating journal entries for loans, savings, shares, and client transactions, managing both cash-based and accrual-based accounting processes.

classes.name: AccountingProcessorHelper
classes.description: A helper utility class providing methods for creating and managing journal entries, populating data transfer objects, and handling account mappings in the context of Fineract's accounting processes.

methods.name: populateLoanDtoFromDTO
methods.description: Constructs a LoanDTO object from the given AccountingBridgeDataDTO, extracting transaction details and related data.

methods.name: getChargeOffMappingByCodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping data for charge-offs based on reason code.

methods.name: getWriteOffMappingByCodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves account mapping data for write-offs based on reason code.

methods.name: getClassificationMappingByCodeValue
methods.description: Gets classification account mappings based on classification ID and type.

methods.name: populateSavingsDtoFromMap
methods.description: Creates a SavingsDTO from raw map data, handling transactions, charges, and tax details.

methods.name: populateSharesDtoFromMap
methods.description: Creates a SharesDTO from raw map data, including share transactions.

methods.name: populateClientTransactionDtoFromMap
methods.description: Builds a ClientTransactionDTO from raw data, including charge payments.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForLoanCharges
methods.description: Creates credit and debit journal entries for loan charges, ensuring account balances.

methods.name: createCashBasedJournalEntriesAndReversalsForSavings

methods.name: createAccrualBasedJournalEntriesAndReversalsForSavings

methods.name: createCashBasedCreditJournalEntriesAndReversalsForSavings
methods.description: Creates cash-based credit journal entries for savings, considering reversals.

methods.name: createAccrualBasedDebitJournalEntriesAndReversalsForSavings

methods.description: Creates cash-based journal entries for savings charges, handling one charge per transaction.

methods.name: createAccrualBasedJournalEntriesAndReversalsForSavingsCharges
methods.description: Creates accrual-based journal entries for savings charges.

methods.name: getOfficeById
methods.description: Retrieves an Office entity from repository by ID.

methods.name: createCreditJournalEntryForLoan
methods.description: Creates a credit journal entry for a loan, linked to specific account and transaction details.

methods.name: createCashBasedJournalEntriesForSharesCharges

methods.name: createCreditJournalEntryOrReversalForClientPayments
methods.description: Creates credit or reversal journal entries for client payments, aggregating account credits and ensuring total consistency.

methods.name: createDebitJournalEntryOrReversalForClientChargePayments
